title: Federal False Statements, Concealment & Official Integrity (18 U.S.C. §§ 1001, 111, 371, 1341, 1343)
summary: Curated statutory, regulatory, and judicial vertical slice tracking material false statements to the federal government (18 U.S.C. § 1001), protection of federal officers (18 U.S.C. § 111), and related conspiracy and fraud provisions across Public Law release points.
scopeNote: Editorial curated topic profile (non-authoritative navigation aid). Statutory text is anchored to OLRC USLM release snapshots; implementing regulations and Supreme Court holdings carry explicit verification and version-alignment states.
curator: Civic Source Legal Architecture Working Group

relatedAuthorities.label: Brogan v. United States, 522 U.S. 398 (1998)
relatedAuthorities.summary: Rejects the 'exculpatory no' doctrine; § 1001 covers any materially false statement of whatever kind within federal jurisdiction.
